formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; have x2 : Bool → List Bool → Prop := fun (x2 : Bool) (x3 : List Bool) => if x2 = Bool.true then ∃ (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x4 - x5 ∈ x1 ∧ x3 = (List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x4)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x5) else ∃ (x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x4.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x6 ∈ x4 | x6 - x5 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) ∧ x3 = (List.ofFn fun (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x5 ∈ x4)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x6 ∈ x4, x6 - x5 ∉ x1); have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x3 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x3 ∧ ∀ (x4 : Bool) (x5 : List Bool), x2 x4 x5 → x3.eval x5 = x4; have x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∃ (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x3 x5 ∧ x5.size < x4.size; have x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>   ∀ x6 < x5.gates.length,     have x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x6;     have x9 : Bool := !x8.op.eval [];     ∀ x10 ∈ x8.inputs, ∃ (x12 : List Bool), x2 x9 x12 ∧ (x5.wires x12).getD x10 Bool.false = !x9 ∧ (x5.wires x12).getD ((26 : ℕ) + x6) Bool.false = x9; ∀ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x3 x6 → x5 x6 → x6.size < (64 : ℕ) → (∃ (x10 : ℕ) (x11 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x6 x10).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x6 x11).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (26 : ℕ) x6 x10 x11) → x4 x6)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3, inputs as in the parent: every fan-in-at-most-two AND/OR circuit reading only earlier wires, true on every incident input and false on every quadrangle input, in which every gate input is witnessed (an OR input false on an incident input where the gate is true, an AND input true on a quadrangle input where the gate is false), with under 64 gates and an AND gate in the cone of another AND gate, has a strictly smaller such circuit.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Part 1 of 2 of a proof of: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input
